description: This file defines a React component for the tasks management page in a task tracker application. It includes state management, data fetching via API calls, and rendering of task list with functionalities to create, update, toggle, and delete tasks.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronously loads tasks from the API, handles loading state and errors.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new task, updates task list, manages loading state.

methods.name: onUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing task, updates task list accordingly.

methods.name: onToggle
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task.

methods.name: onDelete
methods.description: Deletes a task after confirmation, updates task list.
